caption: The drawing depicts a single metal spur, centered on a plain, light beige background. The spur is rendered in shades of gray, indicative of a metallic surface, with shading used to show its three-dimensional form. The object has a large rowel (the rotating wheel with pointed tips) at one end, which is attached to an arm that curves slightly upward and outward. The body of the spur is broad and smooth, featuring a five-pointed star inset or attached to its side, colored in a muted light blue-green. The rest of the spur remains in gray tones. Both ends of the main body terminate in slightly thickened, rounded knobs. To the bottom right of the spur, there is a small, clear label with the name "Ralph Ide Freitas" written in black text. The overall composition is minimal, with the object placed centrally and surrounded by empty negative space.
title: Spur
